BREEDERS_EQUATION.source: Cobb et al. 2019 Enhancing the rate of genetic gain in public-sector plant breeding programs: lessons from the breeder equation
BREEDERS_EQUATION.use: response is governed by additive genetic variation, selection intensity/accuracy and generation interval

CROP_DOMESTICATION_GENETICS.source: Meyer & Purugganan 2013 Evolution of crop species: genetics of domestication and diversification
CROP_DOMESTICATION_GENETICS.use: domestication is a genetic response to selection on multiple traits and can involve selective sweeps, introgression and demographic change

DEMOGRAPHY_AND_VARIATION.source: Gaut et al. 2018 Demography and its effects on genomic variation in crop domestication
DEMOGRAPHY_AND_VARIATION.use: demography, bottlenecks and long pre-domestication human impacts shape standing genomic variation

NO_RETROACTIVE_PHYLOGENY.use: genetic state is operational for managed producer populations and is not a reconstructed 210 Ma flora phylogeny

R334_PARENT.source: R3.34 SEALED Producer Operational Taxon Authority
R334_PARENT.use: 36 taxa, resource contact/management/propagation history and all domestication thresholds are immutable parent authority

SELECTION_DURING_DOMESTICATION.source: Purugganan & Fuller 2009 The nature of selection during plant domestication
SELECTION_DURING_DOMESTICATION.use: plant domestication is modeled as plant-human coevolution under selection rather than an instantaneous state change
